name: IDRX
oneLiner: IDRX is PT IDRX Indo Inovasi's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR fiat reserves and Indonesian government bonds with KYC-gated mint and redeem.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah (IDR) fiat reserves and government bonds held 1:1 by PT IDRX Indo Inovasi; CertiK-audited smart contracts with multisig controls
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of IDRX for Indonesian rupiah through IDRX platform after KYC verification; native multichain deployment with built-in bridge functions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: IDRX documents both direct issuer minting on a selected supported chain and an issuer-operated bridge in which a source burn and its transaction hash are submitted to IDRX before the destination wallet receives IDRX. Its supported-chain page lists the exact current Solana mint and Lisk deployment. Pharos therefore treats the documented route as issuer-native burn/mint rather than a third-party bridge.

mintAuthority.summary: IDRX uses direct issuer-controlled minting. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories were established on 2026-07-30 for every issuer-listed EVM deployment: MINTER_ROLE is held by issuer Safe multisigs (2-of-3, 2-of-8, 2-of-5, and 2-of-7 configurations by chain), one legacy Polygon minter EOA granted 2023-06-27 and never revoked, and a BSC minter assignment at a Safe address that has no deployed contract code on BSC. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which can grant and revoke MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE, is held by the issuer ops EOA 0x5515be1db2a513888f5cf375bf5c7956ee93c779 plus 2-of-3 Safes. UUPS upgrades route through UPGRADER_ROLE on per-chain TimelockController contracts (48 h minimum delay on Polygon, Worldchain, and Lisk; 1 s on BSC), but DEFAULT_ADMIN can reconfigure the role set without delay. On Solana, the current mint is controlled by a single System-Program key (Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn), while the officially deprecated mint's authority is an autonomous Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig (CxFQVMMLzjXgN3eRXUr7mtyBGWxKPeWYJuX6Q97tEy5o) that cannot mint through standard Squads v4 flows; its residual ~77.85M IDRX supply sits outside the June 2026 attestation's Solana figure even though the issuer still honors 1:1 redemption.

Decoded as a Multisig account (PDA derivation independently reproduced from create_key Dkv55puww8b628knJSBCcBALUVT5ipPeF3MsaUrVe4Qm, bump 255): autonomous (config_authority = default), threshold 2 of 3 members (2ZssJYpbFTkygjfhTBSi9FD1ibkgEyjaULBFg3nBYU58, 7ctPsQij7DCaoyyPbzcrvTK6zSCdgDs1uVPdSVLUz8Gz, Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn — all with Initiate|Vote|Execute), time lock 0, transaction_index 2. The Squads v4 program signs arbitrary CPI only with vault PDAs, never with the multisig PDA itself, so minting the deprecated mint is not exercisable through standard Squads v4 flows.

review.evidence: Control review refreshed 2026-07-30. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked event histories were established for Polygon (30 events since deployment block 43038233; hasRole verification pass at block 91160867, 2026-07-30T21:18:41Z), BSC (28 events since deployment block 29948779; hasRole pass at block 113086546, 2026-07-30T22:03:41Z), Worldchain (21 events since deployment block 12683955 via the Alchemy-hosted Blockscout v2 API; hasRole pass at block 33055037, 2026-07-30T21:08:36Z), and Lisk (23 events since deployment block 7994428; hasRole pass at block 35357841 corroborated by a raw-storage pass at block 35358413). An independent second verification at latest blocks on 2026-07-30 re-confirmed every minter Safe's threshold and owners, empty module lists and zero guard slots on all eleven Safes, the timelocks' UPGRADER_ROLE assignments, and getMinDelay = 172800 s on Polygon/Worldchain/Lisk versus 1 s on BSC. Every EVM deployment resolves to the same control family: issuer Safe multisigs mint, the ops EOA 0x5515be1db2a513888f5cf375bf5c7956ee93c779 plus 2-of-3 Safes hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and UUPS upgrades route through per-chain timelocks that DEFAULT_ADMIN can reconfigure. On Solana at finalized slot 436222730 (2026-07-30T20:47:32Z), the current mint idrxZcP8xiKkYk6XGD4uz1dxEYCWSgKDHqgjsBbwDur reported 2 decimals, supply 380,383,124.12 IDRX, no freeze authority, and mint authority Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn, a System-Program account with zero data (a single off-chain key). The deprecated mint idrxTdNftk6tYedPv2M7tCFHBVCpk5rkiNRd8yUArhr reported unchanged supply 77,853,244.28 IDRX with mint authority CxFQVMMLzjXgN3eRXUr7mtyBGWxKPeWYJuX6Q97tEy5o, decoded as an autonomous Squads v4 multisig (2-of-3, time lock 0; members include Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn) whose multisig PDA cannot sign arbitrary CPI in standard Squads v4 flows, so the deprecated mint is practically unmintable. The June 2026 reserve attestation counts only the current Solana mint (348,293,684 IDRX as of 2026-06-19), so the deprecated residual remains outside attested circulation while the issuer still honors 1:1 redemption — a reconciliation caveat, not an unresolved authority. Prior review text follows. Control review refreshed 2026-07-28. At pinned heads Polygon 90920978, Base 49148559, BSC 112281459, Kaia 222886753, Gnosis 47403818, Etherlink 49381661, and Worldchain 32875419, every previously reviewed EVM address returned IDRX name/symbol/decimals and an EIP-1967 implementation slot: Polygon 0xfef07b30e5b453bc372f8a088cfca9276ef8dd79; BSC 0x20fad183dc35f4ae0d1d125ae2f3c4c43a53bbd0; Base, Kaia, Gnosis, Etherlink, and Worldchain 0x36aa37a29378cd3fe12fa67b7e1f0a7558ec8693. The EIP-1967 admin slot is zero on each. The issuer-listed Lisk deployment returned the same 0x36aa37a29378cd3fe12fa67b7e1f0a7558ec8693 implementation and a zero EIP-1967 admin slot at block 35252672. Verified Polygon, BSC, Base, Gnosis, and Etherlink implementation sources are UUPS and _authorizeUpgrade is onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE), so DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is terminal through role administration, not the direct UUPS guard. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked coverage establishes the current direct upgrader and admins on Base, Gnosis, Etherlink, and Kaia; incomplete or absent historical role coverage on Polygon, BSC, Worldchain, and Lisk prevents a truthful aggregate terminal inventory. At finalized Solana slot 435725987 (2026-07-28T10:27:40Z), a batched getMultipleAccounts observation returned the current mint idrxZcP8xiKkYk6XGD4uz1dxEYCWSgKDHqgjsBbwDur with 2 decimals, mint authority Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn, no freeze authority, and raw supply 37990724512 (379,907,245.12 IDRX); that authority account was owned by the System Program. The officially deprecated mint idrxTdNftk6tYedPv2M7tCFHBVCpk5rkiNRd8yUArhr remained initialized with 2 decimals, mint authority CxFQVMMLzjXgN3eRXUr7mtyBGWxKPeWYJuX6Q97tEy5o, no freeze authority, and raw supply 7785324428 (77,853,244.28 IDRX); that authority account was owned by program SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf. Both mints were owned by the immutable SPL Token program; Tokenkeg ProgramData 3gvYRKWyXRR9xKWe1ZjPhLY5ZJRN7KDB4rFZFGoJfFk2 previously reported no program upgrade authority. IDRX's official supported-chain page marks the predecessor deprecated but promises holders 1:1 redemption into current IDRX or rupiah, so its nonzero supply remains a residual issuer liability until reserve attestations and aggregate runtime supply coverage are reconciled.
